items.title: Gibson Brass Band: Joseph Bentley, Albert Miller, Ronald Cayette, Eddie Richardson, George Starling, George…
items.q: We made some records, uh, some years ago. With, uh, which band was this? With, uh, Nat Toe's and his orchestra.

ctx.x: Do you have a daytime job? No. You don't work during the day? You just play music? Mm-hmm. And what is your address? 21, 22 and a half Second Street. Okay. Can you remember anything about Marlenburg and the beach? Marlenburg? Yeah. No. Did you—you never played out there? No. No. Do you remember playing in brass bands years ago? No. You don't? No. This is my first brass band I've played in. You've always played for dances? I've always played in dance orchestra bands. What are some of the dance—the halls that…
Was that with George Williams or—? No, that was with a little small band. That was years ago, you know. Playing with a little small combination. Four, five, and six pieces.
